---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Melissa Gonzalez-Ortiz"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "year_") |>
  filter(!is.na(year_2015), !is.na(year_2023)) |>
  mutate(rla_change = year_2023 - year_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_change)

state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "year_") |>
  filter(!is.na(year_2015), !is.na(year_2023)) |>
  mutate(score_change = year_2023 - year_2015) |>
  mutate(state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, year_2023))
```

```{r}
ggplot(score_change, aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(boundary = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "steelblue", `TRUE` = "orange"),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Negative or zero", `TRUE` = "Positive"),
    name = "Change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years:", nrow(score_change)),
    x = "Change in RLA score (2023 minus 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate decline."
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(state_change, aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = year_2015, xend = year_2023, yend = state_name, color = score_change > 0),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.08, "inches")),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = year_2015), color = "gray50", size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "steelblue", `TRUE` = "orange"),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Declined or unchanged", `TRUE` = "Improved"),
    name = "Change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes, 2015–2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows run from 2015 to 2023; states are ordered by their 2023 score",
    x = "RLA score",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores. Arrow color indicates direction of change."
  )
```
